freeze_rules: Boundary, oracle, calibration, eligibility, overhead methodology, gates, and decision rules below are frozen before headline evaluation. Capture implementation freezes separately in Phase 7 (tree hash recorded). Post-freeze changes allowed only for generic harness correctness defects, classified as protocol amendments.

supported_capture_boundary.request_transport: Node HTTP server (node:http), including frameworks built on node:http where experimentally compatible
supported_capture_boundary.database: Postgres through the pg package (Pool and Client query paths)
outbound_http: undici where reachable through the same instrumentation boundary
supported_capture_boundary.configuration: allowlisted env/config values in CAPTURE_CONFIG (comma-separated names); secret-looking values redacted, never plaintext
supported_capture_boundary.execution_context: one logical inbound request via AsyncLocalStorage
failure_types: request-scoped uncaught application error where observable
out_of_scope: background workers detached from the request

integration_constraint.headline_requirement: at most one generic capture bootstrap integration plus generic configuration; per-incident wrappers around SQL, HTTP, clocks, randomness, or failure assertions forbidden for headline cases

ideal.incident_specific_setup: request identifier or reproduction trigger only

capture_mechanism_frozen_shape.bootstrap: node --import <experiment>/src/capture/register.mjs (zero app source changes); installs CJS Module._load hook + ESM loader hook for pg, global fetch/Date/Math.random patches, ALS, http server listener wrapping
capture_mechanism_frozen_shape.failure_trigger: persist iff response status >= 500 or request-scoped uncaught application exception; else discard
capture_mechanism_frozen_shape.event_order: monotonic request-local sequence numbers for all boundary observations

automatic_oracle.name: FailureFingerprintV2
normalization: never normalize away application error identity
automatic_oracle.safety_rule: missing mock, infra error, unexpected network attempt, DB connection attempt, syntax error, timeout, or unrelated 5xx MUST NOT satisfy the incident fingerprint
automatic_oracle.response_class_rule: 5xx JSON body with error/code fields -> ERR:<code|name>; uncaught exception -> error name + first app frame; else HTTP_<status>

calibration.service_shape: real node:http service + real local Postgres + local fake external HTTP server during capture; both stopped before replay
required_failure_classes: DB row edge case produces HTTP 500
outbound service malformed JSON produces HTTP 500
noise-heavy request with multiple irrelevant DB/HTTP observations
calibration.replay_rule: 20 fresh-process offline replays per full capture; inferred fingerprint must match
calibration.evidence_status: calibration is substrate debugging, not headline product evidence

require: public historical Node.js/TypeScript backend bug predating V2
invokable through a backend HTTP request or bounded HTTP-facing harness without modifying the bug
prefer: genuine application/repository behavior over isolated utility functions
exclude_allowed: not HTTP-facing or unwrappable without changing semantics
cannot run on Node 22 without unrelated breakage
integrity: record all searched candidates with reasons
freeze bug-corpus.json before headline capture runs
no replacement of failed eligible cases

capture_freeze.when: after calibration, before headline bug selection
forbidden_post_freeze: using fixing-patch knowledge to decide what to record

capture_substrate: 8/8 calibration full captures replay exact failure 20/20 offline
0 unexpected live network/database effects during replay
historical_cases: >=70% of eligible bugs reach AUTO_CAPTURE_SUPPORTED without bug-specific wrappers
>=70% of AUTO_CAPTURE_SUPPORTED replay exact inferred failure 20/20 offline
>=70% of replay-supported bugs become reduced portable artifacts
>=80% of evaluable successful reproducers are FIX_CONFIRMED
manual_burden: median incident-specific setup <=5 minutes for AUTO_CAPTURE_SUPPORTED bugs

usefulness_targets: persist only failed-request captures in headline mode
generic integration describable as one bootstrap/configuration step
kill_conditions: bugs routinely require bug-specific wrappers or modeled results
offline replay still requires live database/service
median setup remains near V1 25 minutes
generic integration changes application semantics materially
capture overhead obviously impractical even for selective recording
most real bugs outside the narrow boundary

decision_rules.CONTINUE: frozen generic capture converts a substantial majority of eligible failures into exact offline portable reproducers, median setup <=5 min, zero wrong-failure acceptance, overhead plausibly manageable
decision_rules.MODIFY: automatic capture works strongly for a narrower subset (e.g. Express/Fastify + pg + fetch); narrow the thesis explicitly
decision_rules.KILL: capture/oracle still needs substantial per-bug engineering, replay needs live deps, oracles unsafe, or most cases outside boundary
decision_rules.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: per-bug capture changes post-freeze, hand-authored assertions in headline cases, fixing-patch influence, denominator trimming, or live deps satisfying replay
